$comment: compare-de-1 (24 October 2026): a namespace that exists only for the pages that use it. scripts/translation-check.cjs does not count its keys as missing in a language that is not listed here — a language without the page needs none of its words. Every listed language is checked as usual (missing, extra, ICU, flags). The page falls back to nothing: a country whose language has no `comparison` words has no comparison page (lib/comparison.ts comparePagePath).

comparison.why: the German food-truck ordering-system comparison page (/de/vergleich/foodtruck-bestellsystem); de-AT, de-CH and de-LI inherit de-DE's words
